Why per-vendor: a generic code tells you a scan happened. These tell you whose table it happened at — which is what decides who gets the good spot next month. Read the results with python3 scripts/board_referral.py credit.

Printing: keep the white border around each code. That quiet zone is what lets a phone camera find it at an angle. Anything down to ~1 inch square scans fine.
